card.name: Limits on how fast or how much
card.fires_on: Negating or limiting words such as "no", "not to" and "not be increased" in dosing instructions, right before a cap word like "exceed", "more than", "earlier than" or "until".

modes.label: No before comparison
modes.description: The word "no" introduces a limit such as "no more than", "no earlier than" or "no more frequently than".
modes.example: Treatment course to be repeated<< no>> earlier than 3 days.

modes.label: Not to exceed
modes.description: "not to" comes right before "exceed" to set a maximum amount or concentration.
modes.example: as tolerated to maximum effect, not<< to>> exceed 300 mg/day.

modes.label: Not increased until
modes.description: "increased" follows "should not be" and is followed by a waiting period.
